ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels, with heavy dark pigmentation dominating the central and inner-lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) mass occupying the central fluke and extending towards the trailing edges. High-intensity (white) contiguous zones are localized on the lateral lobes towards the tips. Distinct high-contrast black circular spots are visible on the white field of the left distal lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical depth corresponding to roughly 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire boundary; notable high-amplitude pixel clusters (2-10 pixels) at the extreme distal tips due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric sigmoidal curve initiated by a concave sweep from the notch transitioning into a broad convexity toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast clusters of white/grey nodes at the terminal ends of both lobes, representing dense barnacle colonization. Minor white circular point-clusters visible within the lower-central dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); specifically three near-vertical parallel tracks on the upper-left lobe and several diagonal disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge deformation at the tips due to heavy barnacle encrustation and multiple sets of parallel linear scarring across both ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white speckled mottling at the peduncle-fluke junction, creating a high-frequency salt-and-pepper intensity transition at the water line.
